page_title: NAP 2-2 ACM | Napoli v AC Milan 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom left corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
90+4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.

90+1' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Rade Krunic (AC Milan) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
89' Natan (Napoli) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
87' Stefano Pioli has decided to substitute Marco Pellegrino and he is replaced by Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan).
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alessandro Zanoli (Napoli) was quite harsh and Daniele Orsato didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' The substitution has been made. Alessandro Zanoli (Napoli) has replaced Matteo Politano.
81' Substitution. Luka Jovic (AC Milan) in, Rafael Leao out.
81' Stefano Pioli decides to make a substitution. Olivier Giroud will be replaced by Noah Okafor (AC Milan).
79' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes a mid-range free kick, but his strike goes well wide of the right post.
78' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Yunus Musah (AC Milan) receives a yellow card!
77' It is time for a substitution. Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is on for Piotr Zielinski.
75' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
74' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
73' Leo Ostigard (Napoli) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
72' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for an infringement.
71' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the corner which is cleared.

71' Matteo Politano (Napoli) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
68' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
68' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) prepares to take a corner kick.
67' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alex Meret makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
66' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
65' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
63' 2 - 2 Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes a brilliant free kick and curls the ball inside the right post to give the goalkeeper no chance!
62' Napoli have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
62' Luka Romero (AC Milan) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
62' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

62' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes behind for a corner. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
60' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
59' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

58' Mike Maignan was forced into action to thwart Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
57' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
55' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
54' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniele Orsato stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
53' Natan (Napoli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
53' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.

50' 1 - 2 What outstanding solo play by Matteo Politano (Napoli) as he slipped through inside the box to unleash a shot towards the net. He aimed perfectly and coolly fired it into the roof of the net.
48' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Olivier Giroud (AC Milan), but the defence gets it clear.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) comes off for Luka Romero.
46' Rudi Garcia makes a switch. Leo Ostigard is coming on in place of Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) at the start of the second period.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Rudi Garcia gives a chance to Giovanni Simeone and Eljif Elmas (Napoli) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Rudi Garcia decided to make a change. Mario Rui (Napoli) is replaced by Mathias Olivera.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' A loose ball is pounced on by Yunus Musah (AC Milan) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Alex Meret is alert and makes a comfortable save.
45+4' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
45+4' Daniele Orsato interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Olivier Giroud (AC Milan).

45+4' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan)'s poor effort is easily saved by Alex Meret. He connects well with a cross, but mistimes it a little, and it heads towards the middle of the target and straight into the grateful hands of the goalkeeper.
45+2' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Piotr Zielinski plays a lovely pass into Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
44' Natan (Napoli) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. AC Milan will take a free kick.
44' The shots on goal statistics – 0:2.
43' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Orsato had a clear view and blows his whistle.
41' Good chance! Theo Hernandez laid the ball off to Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) inside the box, he ducked inside his man and rifled a shot in at goal that skimmed the top of the bar.
39' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
39' Mario Rui (Napoli) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
36' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
36' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. AC Milan get a corner.
35' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Daniele Orsato who sees an offensive foul.
34' He should have scored! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
31' 0 - 2 Goal! Davide Calabria picks out Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom left corner with a header from close range. 0:2.

30' It looked like the long-range shot by Mario Rui (Napoli) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
29' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.

28' A cross by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
28' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
27' Matteo Politano (Napoli) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
24' Mike Maignan displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Matteo Politano (Napoli) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

22' 0 - 1 Goal! Christian Pulisic hands Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
22' Daniele Orsato blows his whistle after Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
20' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
19' Pierre Kalulu is being substituted because of an injury. Stefano Pioli sends Marco Pellegrino (AC Milan) on the pitch.
17' Pierre Kalulu (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
16' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) brings his opponent down. Daniele Orsato has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Matteo Politano (Napoli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul.
10' The resulting corner from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is cleared by the defence.
10' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
8' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
7' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
7' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli), but one of the defenders gets it clear. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Napoli have a corner.
6' Mario Rui (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
4' A quickly taken corner by AC Milan.
3' Alex Meret comes off his line to intercept the corner from Theo Hernandez (AC Milan). Now AC Milan have a corner.
2' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Napoli will have the kick-off.
Daniele Orsato will supervise the game today.
